title: Show all students
sql: SELECT * FROM Student;

title: Show name, roll number and cgpa of students, highest cgpa first
sql: SELECT full_name, roll_no, cgpa FROM Student ORDER BY cgpa DESC;

title: Show all faculty members from the Artificial Intelligence department
Show students who took admission in 2024
sql: SELECT roll_no, full_name, admission_year FROM Student WHERE admission_year = 2024;

title: Show all courses that carry 4 credits
sql: SELECT course_name, credits, semester FROM Course WHERE credits = 4;

title: Show all placement drives offering package above 8 LPA
sql: SELECT company_name, drive_date, package_offered FROM Placement_Drive WHERE package_offered > 8;

title: Show top 5 students by cgpa
sql: SELECT full_name, roll_no, cgpa FROM Student ORDER BY cgpa DESC LIMIT 5;

title: Show all exams scheduled after 1st May 2026
sql: SELECT exam_name, exam_date, max_marks FROM Examination WHERE exam_date > '2026-05-01';

title: Show student details along with their department name
Show distinct designations used by faculty members
Total number of students in the campus
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_students FROM Student;

title: Average cgpa of all students
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(cgpa),2) AS average_cgpa FROM Student;

title: Highest and lowest package offered across all placement drives
sql:
SELECT MAX(package_offered) AS highest_package, MIN(package_offered) AS lowest_package
FROM Placement_Drive;

title: Number of students in each department
sql:
SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(s.student_id) AS total_students
FROM Department d
LEFT JOIN Student s ON d.dept_id = s.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name;

title: Total salary paid by the campus to faculty of each department
sql:
SELECT d.dept_name, SUM(f.salary) AS total_salary
FROM Department d
JOIN Faculty f ON d.dept_id = f.dept_id
GROUP BY d.dept_name;


-- ***********************************************************
-- 3. JOIN QUERIES (5)
-- ***********************************************************

title: List every student with the course they attend and the class faculty (INNER JOIN, 3 tables)
sql:
SELECT s.full_name AS student, c.course_name, f.full_name AS faculty
FROM Attendance a
JOIN Student s ON a.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN Course c ON a.course_id = c.course_id
JOIN Faculty f ON c.faculty_id = f.faculty_id;

title: List each student's marks together with the exam and course name
sql:
SELECT s.full_name AS student, e.exam_name, c.course_name, r.marks_obtained, r.grade
FROM Result r
JOIN Student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id
JOIN Examination e ON r.exam_id = e.exam_id
JOIN Course c ON e.course_id = c.course_id;

title: LEFT JOIN - show every student even if they never applied for placement
sql:
SELECT s.full_name, pd.company_name, pr.status
FROM Student s
LEFT JOIN Placement_Record pr ON s.student_id = pr.student_id
LEFT JOIN Placement_Drive pd ON pr.drive_id = pd.drive_id
ORDER BY s.full_name;

title: List courses along with the department and the faculty teaching them
sql:
SELECT c.course_name, d.dept_name, f.full_name AS faculty_name
FROM Course c
JOIN Department d ON c.dept_id = d.dept_id
JOIN Faculty f ON c.faculty_id = f.faculty_id;

title: RIGHT JOIN - show all placement drives and the students placed in them, if any
sql:
SELECT pd.company_name, s.full_name, pr.status
FROM Placement_Record pr
RIGHT JOIN Placement_Drive pd ON pr.drive_id = pd.drive_id
LEFT JOIN Student s ON pr.student_id = s.student_id;

title: Students whose cgpa is above the campus average
Faculty who earn more than the average salary of their own department
Students who have been selected in at least one placement drive
Courses that currently have no exam scheduled
Student with the highest marks in each exam (correlated subquery)
sql:
SELECT e.exam_name, s.full_name, r.marks_obtained
FROM Result r
JOIN Examination e ON r.exam_id = e.exam_id
JOIN Student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE r.marks_obtained = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.marks_obtained) FROM Result r2 WHERE r2.exam_id = r.exam_id
);

title: Update a student's cgpa after result declaration
sql: UPDATE Student SET cgpa = 9.10 WHERE roll_no = 'FDAI001';

title: Give a 10% salary hike to all Professors
sql: UPDATE Faculty SET salary = salary * 1.10 WHERE designation = 'Professor';

title: Mark a placement application as Selected
sql:
UPDATE Placement_Record SET status = 'Selected'
WHERE student_id = 3 AND drive_id = 2;

title: Correct the max marks of an exam
sql: UPDATE Examination SET max_marks = 100 WHERE exam_name = 'Unit Test 1' AND max_marks <> 100;

title: Update phone number of a student
Remove a single wrong attendance entry
sql: DELETE FROM Attendance WHERE attendance_id = 30;

title: Remove placement applications that were rejected before 2026
sql: DELETE FROM Placement_Record WHERE status = 'Rejected' AND placement_id = 20;

title: Remove a faculty record that was entered by mistake (course reassigned first)
sql: DELETE FROM Faculty WHERE faculty_id = 20;

title: Remove exam records with zero marks entered by mistake
sql: DELETE FROM Result WHERE marks_obtained = 0;

title: Remove a placement drive that got cancelled
Add a new column to store student's blood group
sql: ALTER TABLE Student ADD COLUMN blood_group VARCHAR(5);

title: Add a new column to store the mode of a class (Online/Offline)
sql: ALTER TABLE Course ADD COLUMN mode VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'Offline';

title: Modify phone number column length in Faculty table
sql: ALTER TABLE Faculty MODIFY COLUMN phone VARCHAR(20);

title: Rename a column in Placement_Drive for clarity
sql: ALTER TABLE Placement_Drive RENAME COLUMN package_offered TO package_lpa;

title: Drop the unused blood_group column (shown for reference/undo)
Students whose name starts with 'A'
sql: SELECT full_name FROM Student WHERE full_name LIKE 'A%';

title: Faculty whose email is on the campus.edu.in domain
sql: SELECT full_name, email FROM Faculty WHERE email LIKE '%@campus.edu.in';

title: Courses with 'Data' anywhere in the course name
sql: SELECT course_name FROM Course WHERE course_name LIKE '%Data%';

title: Companies whose name ends with 'a'
sql: SELECT company_name FROM Placement_Drive WHERE company_name LIKE '%a';

title: Students whose roll number matches the pattern FDAI0_1 (2nd last digit is 1)
sql: SELECT roll_no, full_name FROM Student WHERE roll_no LIKE 'FDAI0_1';
